CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SAN DIEGO
CLOSED SESSION AGENDA
FOR
Monday, May 18, 2026, AT 10:00 AM
CITY ADMINISTRATION BUILDING
COUNCIL CHAMBERS – 12 TH FLOOR
202 “C” STREET
SAN DIEGO, CA 92101
Virtual Participation: https://sandiego.gov/councilmtg
To join by telephone: Dial 1-669 254 5252 + input Webinar ID: 160 943 0466
_________________
NOTE : In accordance with the San Diego City Council Permanent Rules for Noticing and Conduct of Closed Session Meetings, adopted by Resolution No. R-310153 on December 8, 2015, a portion of the regular open meeting agenda of the City Council has been reserved for City Attorney comment, public comment, and City Council discussion of the content of this Closed Session Agenda. Public testimony for this Closed Session Agenda will be taken today during the 10:00 a.m. Council meeting. Court records about existing litigation are available to the public on the San Diego Superior Court’s Website http://www.sdcourt.ca.gov and Register of Actions http://odyroa.sdcourt.ca.gov .
CONSENT ITEMS
Staff presentations on Consent items will be waived unless a request is made by any Councilmember for a specific item to be heard during the Discussion portion of the Closed Session agenda. Requests may be made by notifying the Mayor or presiding officer.
Conference with Legal Counsel – Existing Litigation, pursuant to California Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1):
CS-1 The Sustainability Institute, et al. v. Donald J. Trump, et al.
United States District Court, District of South Carolina
Case No.: 2:25-cv-02152-RMG
Risk Management Department Claim File No. N/A
DCA Assigned: N. Markowitz
This case challenges executive orders issued by the Trump Administration blocking grant funding to various entities including the City. The City Attorney’s Office will update the Mayor and City Council on the status of the litigation and seek direction.
CS-2 Magdalena Gracia v. City of San Diego
San Diego Superior Court Case No. 24CU029640C
Risk Management Department Claim File No. 38392
DCA Assigned: O. Palizzolo
This case arises from a trip and fall that occurred on a sidewalk in front of the property located at 1727 Grand Avenue in Pacific Beach on July 3, 2024. The City Attorney’s Office will update the Mayor and City Council on the status of litigation and seek direction.
CS-3 Maria Del Rocio Nunez Munoz v. City of San Diego
San Diego Superior Court Case No. 37-2024-00017991-CU-PO-CTL
Risk Management Department Claim File No. 30842
DCA Assigned: H. R. Whitehead
This matter arises from an alleged trip and fall on the sidewalk near 4059 Wilson Avenue on May 5, 2022. The City Attorney’s Office will update the Mayor and City Council on the status of the litigation and seek direction.

Conference with Legal Counsel – Existing Litigation, pursuant to California Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1):

San Diego Superior Court Case No. 37-2021-00030939-CU-WM-CTL
Risk Management Department Claim File No. 27172
DCA Assigned: C. C. Hawkins
Outside Counsel: M. A. Wharton, Senior Counsel, Colantuono, Highsmith & Whatley PC
Plaintiff alleges the City violated Proposition 218 related to charges in the Public Utility Department's Industrial Wastewater Control Program. The City Attorney’s Office will update the Mayor and City Council on the status of the litigation and seek direction.

Risk Management Department Claim File Nos. 31684 and 40288
DCA Assigned: L. Gantney
